title: Concept: Crate dependency declared optional without a feature gate
description: Cargo.toml declares an optional dependency whose feature is never named, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an optional dependency whose feature is never named.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an optional dependency whose feature is never named.
